summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans large model repositories like Hugging Face—which surpassed 3 million public models in August 2026—and a growing tier of developer-facing inference platforms (Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, and others) that make open-weight models easy to run via API or locally. Download distribution is highly concentrated: roughly half of all Hugging Face models have fewer than 200 downloads, while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads, and China has recently surpassed the U.S. in monthly model downloads. These hubs and inference APIs are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and managed MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open access, self-hosting, and low-friction developer inference.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering open-source models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus hosted inference endpoints for deployment.
platforms.pricing: Free hosting for public models; Pro ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and dedicated compute billed per-hour/usage; Enterprise plans available
features: Largest open model and dataset repository
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open libraries
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Model cards, versioning, and community collaboration
platforms.best_for: Researchers, developers, and organizations needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaborative tooling

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first runtime for downloading and running open LLMs on personal machines or servers with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.), plus GGUF imports from Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs on your own hardware (no usage fees)
features: One-command local model download and run
Quantized GGUF model support for consumer hardware
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
Growing support for multimodal and embedding models
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users wanting to run open models locally without cloud dependency

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform to run and deploy open-source and custom models via API, packaging models as reproducible containers (Cog).
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across text, image, video, and audio
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); no monthly minimum
features: Run models via simple REST/HTTP API
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong support for image/video generation models
Public model marketplace with versioned deployments
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to call or deploy open models (especially generative media) via API without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: Inference and fine-tuning cloud optimized for open and open-weight LLMs, offering fast, scalable API access and dedicated endpoints.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; dedicated GPU instances and fine-tuning billed per usage/hour
features: Support for the latest open-weight LLMs and image models
Batch inference and reasoning model support
platforms.best_for: Startups and enterprises building production apps on open-weight LLMs needing performance and fine-tuning

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Production-grade, speed-optimized inference platform for open-source and fine-tuned LLMs and multimodal models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open and optimized models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; dedicated deployments and fine-tuning billed by usage/GPU-hour
features: FireAttention engine for low-latency, high-throughput serving
Function calling and structured JSON output
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model deployment
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies needing fast, cost-efficient production inference for open models

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: Inference platform offering fast, affordable API access to a wide range of open-source LLMs and multimodal models, popular in the Chinese and global open ecosystem.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Llama, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token usage; competitive/low-cost tiers with some free quotas for select models
features: Broad support for leading Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video model support
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting low-cost access to Chinese and global open-weight models, especially DeepSeek and Qwen families

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: Ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open-weight LLMs at very high speeds.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Gemma, DeepSeek distillations)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, priced competitively; free developer tier available
features: Custom LPU inference hardware for extreme speed
Support for popular open-weight chat models
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time applications on open models

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pass-through pricing with a small routing margin; prepaid credits
features: Single API for many providers and models
Price and performance comparison across providers
Access to both open-weight and frontier closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting flexible, provider-agnostic access to many models through one integration

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: Serverless cloud for running custom AI/ML workloads and model inference with code-first GPU infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: Unlimited custom models (bring-your-own); supports any open model you deploy
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second compute billing for CPU/GPU usage; free starter credits
features: Deploy any open model as an API
platforms.best_for: ML engineers wanting to deploy custom open models and pipelines with code-first serverless infrastructure
